Zusammenfassung: ""Buddenbroki. Istorii︠a︡ gibeli odnogo semeĭstva" -- debi︠u︡tnyĭ roman vydai︠u︡shchegosi︠a︡ nemet︠s︡kogo pisateli︠a︡ Tomasa Manna (1875-1955), otmechennyĭ Nobelevskoĭ premieĭ po literature (1929). "Estʹ nechto neobychaĭnoe v svoevolii proizvedenii︠a︡", -- pisal Mann o rabote nad pervoĭ knigoĭ. Zadumannai︠a︡ kak nebolʹshoĭ "kupecheskiĭ" roman na dvesti pi︠a︡tʹdesi︠a︡t stranit︠s︡, ona prevratilasʹ v khroniku neskolʹkikh pokoleniĭ predprinimatelʹskoĭ dinastii iz starinnogo goroda Li︠u︡beka. Osnovateli︠u︡ dinastii, torgovt︠s︡u zernom Iogannu Buddenbroku, udalosʹ razbogatetʹ i zasluzhitʹ uvazhenie gorozhan. Odnako semeĭnoe predprii︠a︡tie -- radostʹ i gordostʹ Ioganna -- prinosit ego deti︠a︡m i vnukam ne bezmi︠a︡tezhnoe spokoĭstvie, a serʹeznye ispytanii︠a︡..."--(Provided by publisher.)

Zusammenfassung: Chronicles the decline of a German merchant clan. Ranging from 1835 to 1877, the semi-autobiographical tale explores not only the fate of an individual family but also the crisis of an entire social class along with moral and philosophical themes related to duty, self-expression, and appearance versus reality.
